description: Google hooks: a permissionDecision 'ask' gate on every tool in the confirm class of data/tools.json (calendar create/update/delete/respond, which email other people; Gmail trash and spam; Drive create, copy and revision upload; and, with the REST fallback on, sending a draft and Drive trash, move, share and unshare). The hook is a fixed printf with no script, so there is nothing that can fail open. A test keeps this matcher in step with data/tools.json. Hosts other than Claude Code read the confirm class from data/tools.json and gate it themselves.

hooks.command: printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Google: this change can send mail, email other people (invitations, cancellations, replies to organisers), share or move Drive files where others see them, or trash mail and files. Please confirm it yourself."}}'
